text.content:
Illusionists are masters of deception and manipulation, blurring the lines of reality to protect their allies and disorient their foes.

SKILLS

ILLUSIONIST MAGIC · SL max 10

Each time you acquire this Skill, learn one Illusionist spell. Offensive [Z] Illusionist spells and Phantasms use (INS + WLP) for their Magic Checks.

PHANTASMAL RESIDUE · SL max 5

Once per round, after one or more of your Phantasms shatter as part of a Command spell, you gain one Phantasmal Residue. You can store a maximum of (SL) Residues. When you cast a spell, you may spend any amount of Residues to reduce that spell's MP cost by 2 per Residue.

PHANTASMAL RECOVERY · SL max 5

Shatter one of your Phantasms to recover (SL × 5) HP.

PHANTASMAL RECYCLING

When you cast a spell, if you don't have enough MP to pay for its total cost, you may choose to shatter one of your Phantasms for a 10 MP bonus. You cannot use this skill to create a Phantasm.

THE PLEDGE

At the start of a conflict scene, spend 10 MP to create one Phantasm. Triggers on the Turn when swapping in mid-conflict.

RITUAL ILLUSIONISM

You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the Illusionism discipline. Illusionism Rituals use (INS + WLP) for the Magic Check.

RULES

Phantasms. Phantasms follow a set of special rules.

  • You may perform one action and conjure a Phantasm through any of the following spells: The Creeps, The Heckler, The Clout, or The Prestige (Heroic). Phantasms are entities of pure energy, capable of taking on various sizes and forms — even becoming exact replicas of you!
  • When you first create a Phantasm, you can use its specific listed ability as a free action.
  • Unless stated otherwise, Phantasms do not get a turn. On any subsequent turn after a Phantasm is created, you may choose to spend an action to use its specific ability again by performing another Magic Check, but spending only 5 MP.
  • Beyond their unique abilities, on any subsequent turn after a Phantasm is created, it can also be subject to commands through a Command spell. You may use an action to command one or more Phantasms, depending on the wording of the command spell. Command spells always shatter the Phantasm.
  • Phantasms always target Magical Defense.
  • Unless stated otherwise, they cannot be targeted by enemies, and you can have up to 3 Phantasms active at the same time.
  • Your Phantasms shatter if you fall to 0 HP, or if you leave the scene. You can also shatter them through skills and spells.
  • They do not talk or have a mind of their own, and are not capable of reason or logic.
  • Outside of a combat scene, they only follow simple one-clause commands and cannot abstract meaning or extrapolate from them.

SPELLS

The Creeps [Z] · 10 MP · One creature · Scene

You may spend one action to conjure a terrifying Phantasm. Choose either weaken or shaken: the Phantasm inflicts the chosen status effect on the target hit by this spell. On any subsequent turn, you can perform an action and perform another Magic Check to use the Phantasm's ability again, spending only 5 MP.

The Heckler [Z] · 10 MP · One creature · Scene

You may spend one action to create a vexing Phantasm that taunts and distracts your foe. For the next Attack action, if the target rolls an even number for Accuracy Check, the attack misses. On any subsequent turn, you can perform an action and perform another Magic Check to use the Phantasm's ability again, spending only 5 MP.

The Clout [Z] · 10 MP · One creature · Scene

You may spend one action to create a Phantasm and command it to attack a creature. The target hit by the Phantasm suffers (HR + 12) damage. This damage increases to 16 if you are level 20 or higher, or to 18 if you are level 40 or higher. The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon. On any subsequent turn, you can perform an action and perform another Magic Check to use the Phantasm's ability again, spending only 5 MP. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances.

Gilding · 10 MP · One weapon · Scene

You make a weapon appear as if it were imbued with soul energy. Choose a damage type: light or dark. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon is of this type. If you have that weapon equipped while casting this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.

The Whip-Round · 10 × T MP · Up to three allies · Instantaneous

You command your Phantasms to replenish your allies' MP. Each Phantasm runs towards a companion and shatters itself in a spray of mana. Each target recovers 20 MP. A single ally cannot be replenished by more than one Phantasm per action.

Patching · 10 × T MP · Up to three allies · Instantaneous

You command your Phantasms to heal your allies. Each Phantasm runs towards a companion and shatters itself in a cloud of healing energy. Each target recovers 20 HP. A single ally cannot be healed by more than one Phantasm per action.

The Dazzle [Z] · 5 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You command all your active Phantasms to shatter with a blinding light. Choose either dazed or shaken: you inflict the chosen status effect on each target hit by this spell.

The Scatter [Z] · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You command all your Phantasms to charge at your foes, shattering them on impact. They all share the same Magic Check. Each affected target suffers (HR + 15) physical damage. You can target only one foe per Phantasm. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances.

The Bang [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You overflow one Phantasm with energy, making it explode to devastating effect. Choose a damage type: light or dark. The target hit by this spell suffers (HR + 25) damage of the chosen type. This shatters the Phantasm.

The Double · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

When another creature is threatened by an attack, spell, or other danger, command one Phantasm to take their place. Any Checks that are part of the danger will be performed against the Phantasm. The Phantasm shields the creature from damage and status effects, shattering in the process.

Grand Finale [Z] · 20 MP · One creature · Instantaneous

You command all your active Phantasms to charge at a single enemy with incredible speed, shattering on impact. They all share a single Magic Check. If they hit, the target suffers (HR + 10) physical damage per Phantasm and dazed. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances. This damage increases to 15 per Phantasm if you are level 20 or higher, or to 20 if you are level 40 or higher.

The Bottle · 10 × T MP · Up to three creatures · Instantaneous

You create an illusion that makes your companions feel healthier and refreshed for a while. For their next 3 turns, they gain 40 additional HP — this increases both their maximum and their current HP by 40. This amount increases to 50 HP if you are level 20 or higher, or to 60 HP if you are level 40 or higher. After 3 turns, they lose this additional HP. If reduced to 0 HP at the end of the spell, the Sacrifice and Surrender rules apply as normal.
